description:
About our brand and products:
RunnerVits is a UK supplement brand built exclusively for runners. Our range is designed around the runner's routine rather than the generic sports-nutrition shelf: Morning Runner Essentials, Pre-Race Performance, Evening Recovery & Sleep, Runner Joint Support, Daily Hydrate & Perform and High-Strength Omega-3. Products are formulated to work together across training, race day and recovery, with no unnecessary overlap. We're a registered UK company with a trademarked brand, shipping direct to customers nationwide.

What makes us different:
Most running supplements are repackaged general sports products. Ours are made for one athlete: the runner. Formulations are science-led and built around the specific demands of endurance training — mileage, impact, sleep quality and hydration. Our core range is tested against the Cologne List, giving athletes confidence in what they're taking. We keep the range deliberately focused rather than selling dozens of overlapping SKUs, and every product earns its place in a runner's routine.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn 10% commission on net sales generated through their unique tracking link or discount code. Your audience receives 10% off their first order, giving you a genuine incentive to share rather than a hard sell. Average order value is around £40, and our bundles (Marathon, Park Run and Beginner Runner) push that higher. Commission is tracked automatically through your link, with a 30-day cookie window, and paid on a regular schedule. There are no caps on what you can earn and no minimum sales requirement to stay in the programme.

How to promote us:
Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Strava, blogs, newsletters, running club communities and coaching platforms all work well for us. We provide product imagery, athlete content, brand assets and copy guidance so you're never starting from a blank page. Honest, first-person content performs best — your own training routine, race prep or recovery. Paid search bidding on our brand terms and coupon/voucher aggregator sites are not permitted.

Other information:
RunnerVits currently ships within the UK, so UK-focused audiences convert best. We work with runners, coaches, clubs, physios and running content creators of all sizes — engagement matters more to us than follower count. Applications are reviewed individually and we'll be in touch with your code and link once approved. Any health or performance claims must stay within UK advertising and food-supplement regulations; we'll share approved wording to keep this simple.
